subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield on a subagent's first turn (no children, no wake source) silently finalizes the run as ok with an empty result — tool descriptions invite the misuse

question: Should `sessions_yield` reject a call when the runtime has no tracked continuation source, or accept it while recording a distinct visible degenerate outcome?
rationale: Source establishes the unsafe state, but maintainers must define which runtime events count as valid continuations and whether invalid yield is a tool error or a terminal lifecycle outcome.

options.title: Reject unsafe yield
options.body: Return a corrective tool error and keep the turn running whenever no active child or other tracked continuation source exists.

options.title: Record degenerate completion
options.body: Allow the turn to end but classify and announce it as an explicit incomplete or yielded-empty outcome rather than success.

recommendation.title: Reject unsafe yield
recommendation.body: Return a corrective tool error and keep the turn running whenever no active child or other tracked continuation source exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice defines core orchestration semantics across direct and spawned agent runs, making the project owner the best available decision route despite weak file-history provenance.
